title: React vs Vue vs Angular - Which one to choose?
explanation: React dominates the market (~40% market share), Vue offers the gentlest learning curve, and Angular is the most complete framework for large enterprise teams.

whenToUse.scenario: Projects of any scale, freelance work, and startups. A massive community ensures endless ecosystem packages and solutions.
Small to medium projects, especially if transitioning from vanilla JS. Popular in Asian markets and ideal for fast onboarding.
Large-scale enterprise software with multiple developers requiring strict structure and out-of-the-box architecture.

title: WordPress vs Headless CMS - Traditional or Modern?
explanation: WordPress powers over 43% of the web. Headless CMS solutions represent modern architecture but require higher technical setup.

whenToUse.scenario: Blogs, corporate sites, and SMB e-commerce. Perfect for fast deployment without custom development.
Omnichannel content delivery (web, mobile apps, IoT). Enterprise teams with dedicated budget.
You want a free, self-hosted headless CMS with full control over your server and Node.js backend.
Real-time collaborative editing and highly flexible structured content requirements.

title: Salesforce vs HubSpot vs Zoho - Which CRM?
explanation: Salesforce is the global #1 enterprise leader, HubSpot excels in inbound marketing, and Zoho offers high cost-effective flexibility.

whenToUse.scenario: Large corporations requiring custom automation workflows and massive scalability.
Growing businesses focused on content marketing, lead generation, and email automation.
Small to medium businesses looking for a complete CRM on a budget.

title: Tailwind vs SASS/LESS - Utility-first or Preprocessor?
explanation: Tailwind is rapidly growing as the modern standard, while SASS remains the classic preprocessor favorite. Both are production-grade.

whenToUse.scenario: Modern component-based stacks (React/Vue/Next). Allows rapid prototyping without managing external CSS files.
Large legacy codebases or complex custom design systems utilizing traditional stylesheets.

title: Google Analytics vs Tag Management
explanation: Google Analytics is the de facto web standard (~85% market share). GTM simplifies tag deployments alongside GA.

whenToUse.scenario: Any website needing traffic insight, user acquisition metrics, and event tracking.
Managing multiple marketing tags and pixels without constantly modifying source code.

title: Docker vs Traditional Deployment
explanation: Docker containerization is the modern industry standard for reliable multi-environment deployments.

whenToUse.scenario: Professional software team environments to ensure code runs identically across local development and production.

title: API vs RESTful API vs JSON/REST API - What's the difference?
explanation: API is the general concept, RESTful is the architectural style, and JSON/REST API is the practical implementation format.

whenToUse.scenario: Combines REST architecture with JSON data payload. Used by over 90% of modern web applications.
Represents strict adherence to REST architectural constraints (HTTP verbs, statelessness, clean URLs).

title: Server Components vs Client Components - Where to render?
explanation: Server Components (RSC) run exclusively on the server sending pre-rendered HTML. Client Components run in the browser to enable user interactivity.

whenToUse.scenario: 🖥️ SERVER COMPONENTS (default in Next.js App Router): Use for static content, database fetches, and non-interactive UI. ⚡ Faster initial page load and better security.
💻 CLIENT COMPONENTS (opt-in via 'use client'): Use for interactive elements (button clicks, form state, useEffect, event listeners).

transitionDifficulty.timeEstimate: 2-3 weeks to internalize the mental model shift
